reigns.note: Son of Agenor and Telephassa who, failing to recover Europa, settled the southern coast of Asia Minor and gave his name to Cilicia — the Agenorid migration strand from which Pamphylian Greeks traced their kinship with the Cretan diaspora.

Zeus-born son of Europa who fled Crete after Minos' victory and carved out a kingdom in Lycia; Pausanias cites the kinship of Pamphylians with Cretans who came of old from Crete, having fled along with Sarpedon.
The Pamphylians belong to the Greek race, being among those who after the taking of Troy wandered with Calchas — the post-war settlement wave that peopled Pamphylia, where Side lies on the Melas.
During the raids that preceded the Trojan War, Achilles took Side among the coastal cities of Asia Minor.
